results.title: India and Europe accelerate trade ties - Brussels Signal
results.snippet:
The economic figures explain the interest.

According to Eurostat data published by the Council of the EU, merchandise trade between India and the EU-27 reached €118 billion in 2025. Europe imported €69.5 billion worth of Indian goods and exported €48.9 billion, resulting in a trade deficit of €20.6 billion.
